info.name: MiniCRM
info.summary: Custom MiniCRM for Nextcloud with Files, Calendar, Deck and n8n integration
info.description: Lightweight and powerful CRM app for Nextcloud tailored for tax and professional practices. Seamlessly integrates customer intake from Easypoint via n8n, automates client folder creation with public file drop links, coordinates Nextcloud Calendar events, creates Deck cards, and provides a multichannel communication timeline.
info.author: ViolaTax
